term.block/v1 — rendered gallery
================================

Generated by tests/term_block_gallery.rs; regenerate with
TERM_BLOCK_GALLERY=overwrite. Each panel is the widget's own output with
ANSI stripped, framed at its viewport width. A `·` is a space the widget
PAINTED; a bare gap is a line that simply ended. The frame's right edge is
the terminal's, so content touching it is content that filled the row.


── ascii · word wrap, and a right column that fits ── width 24
              1         2    
     123456789012345678901234
   ┌────────────────────────┐
  1│·Read·a·long·filename···│
  2│···················done·│
   └────────────────────────┘

── ascii · a right column too wide to share the line ── width 14
              1    
     12345678901234
   ┌──────────────┐
  1│·Read·a·long··│
  2│·filename·····│
  3│·exit·1·(128s·│
   └──────────────┘

── ascii · the three wrap modes on one string ── width 18
              1        
     123456789012345678
   ┌──────────────────┐
  1│none:··antidisesta│
  2│word:·············│
  3│antidisestablishme│
  4│ntarian···········│
  5│exact:·antidisesta│
  6│blishmentarian····│
   └──────────────────┘

  1│·端末のブロ··│

  3│·する········│
  4│·端末·mixed··│
  5│·幅··········│
  6│··········ok·│
   └─────────────┘

              1         2

  2│café·résumé·······1x│
